RadioTower4FFisherText:
I listened to the
radio while I was at the RUINS.

I heard a strange
broadcast there.
RadioTower4FDJMaryText:
MARY: Why? Why do
I have to suffer through this?

MEOWTH, help me!
RadioTower4FDJMaryText_ClearedRockets:

my little savior!

Will you take this
as my thanks?
RadioTower4FDJMaryText_GivePinkBow:
MARY: It's just
right for #MON

that know normal-
type moves.
RadioTower4FDJMaryText_After:
MARY: Please tune
into me on PROF.

OAK'S #MON TALK
show.
GruntM10SeenText:
You plan to rescue
the DIRECTOR?

That won't be pos-
sible because I'm going to beat you!
GruntM10AfterBattleText:
I don't believe
it! I was beaten!
Executivem2SeenText:
Stop! I'm known as
the TEAM ROCKET fortress!

You're not taking
another step!
Executivem2AfterBattleText:
You've earned my
respect, so here's some advice.

It's not too late.
You can still turn back.
GruntF4SeenText:
Don't I think
#MON are cute?

I'll think my
#MON are cute--

after they beat
yours!
GruntF4AfterBattleText:
I love my
beautiful self!

Who cares about
#MON?
ScientistRichSeenText:
Most excellent.

This RADIO TOWER
will fulfill our grand design.
ScientistRichBeatenText:

All grand plans
come with snags.
ScientistRichAfterBattleText:
Do you honestly
believe you can stop TEAM ROCKET?
